1.

Product Overview

Built for low temperature. Designed for performance — doors engineered for the demands of the cold chain.

Cold Storage Doors are specially engineered to maintain low temperature conditions, ensure energy efficiency, and provide reliable operation in refrigerated and frozen environments.

These doors offer excellent insulation, airtight sealing and durability for demanding applications in cold rooms, freezers and temperature-controlled facilities.

Available in hinged, sliding, vertical lift and roller configurations to match the traffic, opening size and temperature range of every application.

Thermal Insulation

Minimizes energy loss across the coldest environments.

Airtight Sealing

Maintains set temperature and humidity levels.

Configurations

Hinged, sliding, vertical lift and roller options.

Extreme Conditions

Built for chilled, frozen and blast-freezer ranges.
